pages.speaker: npc
lines: If you run into a Pokemon you really want, try throwing a Quick Ball right away!

action: q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run tellraw @s[tag=ItemLoot69] {"text":"You have already claimed this loot!","italic":true,"color":"gray"}');
q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run give @s[tag=!ItemLoot69] cobblemon:quick_ball 3');
q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run tellraw @s[tag=!ItemLoot69] {"text":"You received 3 Quick Balls!","italic":true,"color":"gray"}');
q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run playsound itemget ambient @s[tag=!ItemLoot69] ~ ~ ~ 1 1 1');
q.run_command('execute as ' + q.player.username + ' run tag @s[tag=!ItemLoot69] add ItemLoot69');
